summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Nutriscan (Expo/React Native + FastAPI + Gemini 3 Flash). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass individually; profile CRUD with BMR/TDEE (Mifflin-St Jeor) verified, meals CRUD + summary + progress verified, /meals/scan analyzed a real salad photo and returned valid nutrition JSON, /mealplan/generate produced a 7-day plan. Frontend: 6-step onboarding flow completes and redirects to tabs; Home, Plan (empty), Progress (stats + 7-day chart + profile summary), and Scan screens all render correctly with expected content in French.

minor.issue: Emergent LLM concurrency limit (429 CONCURRENCY_REQUEST_LIMIT) when both AI endpoints hit in parallel. Sequential execution works fine. Not a code bug — provider plan limitation. Consider serializing/queuing AI calls or documenting the constraint.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab bar items lack testID props (no scan-tab / plan-tab / progress-tab / home-tab). Navigation still works via visible label text, but adds testIDs would improve test robustness.
'Galerie' button missing testID (scan-camera-button exists but scan-gallery-button missing).
'Réinitialiser mon profil' reset control missing testID (progress-reset-button).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. — cosmetic only.

action_items: Add testIDs to tab bar items in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (home-tab, scan-tab, plan-tab, progress-tab) for reliable E2E navigation.
Add testID='scan-gallery-button' to the Galerie button in app/(tabs)/scan.tsx.
Add testID='progress-reset-button' to the reset control in app/(tabs)/progress.tsx.
Optional: replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' to silence React Native Web console warning.
Optional: throttle/queue AI calls or inform users that scan + plan generation can't run concurrently on current LLM plan (429 concurrency limit).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses env vars correctly (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY), strips _id from all Mongo reads, uses UUIDs for ids, and validates via Pydantic. No hardcoded secrets.
Mifflin-St Jeor implementation is correct; verified against 30yo male 180cm/75kg moderate/maintain -> 2682 kcal.
extract_json helper handles markdown code fences robustly, good.
MealPlan.days typed as List[dict] — acceptable since AI schema is nested, but a stricter Pydantic model would improve validation.
No auth as per spec (local AsyncStorage profile) — acceptable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 when run sequentially; 12/13 in parallel run due to LLM concurrency limit — not a bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (onboarding + all 4 tab screens render + navigation)

seed_data_creation: Created a profile via UI onboarding (Alex, 30yo, male, 180cm, 75kg, moderate, maintain -> 2682 kcal) and via backend tests (TEST_User). One TEST_Oatmeal meal was created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://health-meal-planner-12.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. NOTE: running the two AI tests in parallel hits Emergent LLM concurrency 429; run pytest without xdist parallelism when re-testing AI, or split into two invocations. Frontend flow: onboarding must be completed within one browser session (AsyncStorage does not persist across separate Playwright sessions). Use text-based selectors for tab navigation until tab testIDs are added.
rca_of_issue: The single parallel-run failure of /api/meals/scan is a rate-limit response (HTTP 429 CONCURRENCY_REQUEST_LIMIT) from the Emergent LLM proxy when /api/mealplan/generate is already in flight. Cause: current LLM plan disallows concurrent requests. Reproduction: run pytest with pytest-xdist so TestAIScan and TestAIMealPlan execute simultaneously. Mitigation: run AI tests serially, upgrade LLM plan, or add server-side queueing/backoff around LlmChat.send_message.
